title: Gone To The Dogs - Lone Pine Kennels 2025
summary: The episode takes place midway through a seven-day and night hound-hunting adventure that has become an annual affair for Fielder and Smith. The friends discuss the previous three nights of coon hunting and the accompanying afternoons running Smith’s beagles on Pennsylvania cottontails. True to Smith’s preferences in coonhounds, each of Smith’s rabbit runners is a female.

key_points.text: True to Smith’s preferences in coonhounds, each of Smith’s rabbit runners is a female.
The episode runs the gamut of subjects from play by plays of the week’s hunts, current hounds in the Lone Pine stable.
Smith is always a good listen as he cordially reveals the inner comings and goings of the nation’s most successful breeding kennel in the coonhound sport..
